findings.summary: Theme is fixed rather than preference-driven.
findings.evidence: Home screenshots are pixel-identical in default and prefers-color-scheme: dark, and the rendered CSS exposes no preference-driven theme signal. The dark palette is usable, but it does not respond to the user preference.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Route and state changes have no View Transition treatment.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no view-transition CSS; navigation is conventional full-page replacement.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive cross-document View Transitions for same-origin navigation, respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: Long-feed navigation chrome is not scroll-state aware.
findings.evidence: The Explore page is 4,978 CSS px tall, while screenshots and CSS inspection show fixed/static navigation with no scroll-state query or progress affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a sticky, compacting header or a lightweight scroll progress/position affordance, with CSS scroll-state where supported.

findings.summary: Overlay controls use legacy custom dialogs without anchor positioning.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found three role=dialog controls, zero native dialogs/popovers, and no anchor-name or position-anchor CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Move transient menus to popover and anchor positioning with position-try fallbacks.

findings.summary: Overlays are custom role=dialog elements rather than native dialog/popover primitives.
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM contains three role=dialog elements but zero <dialog> and zero [popover] elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for modal flows and popover for transient menus, preserving declarative light-dismiss and focus behavior.

findings.summary: Responsive components rely on global layout rules only.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no @container rules, although the card grid is reused across listing and 404 contexts.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card/grid components containment and adapt them with container queries rather than viewport-only assumptions.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated on primary navigation.
findings.evidence: The focus probe focused visible nav links and the menu button; computed outline style was none and box-shadow was none.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible treatment and keep pointer/touch target sizing at least as large as the current 44px menu target.

findings.summary: The core Explore-to-album journey intermittently dead-ends at the CDN.
findings.evidence: A representative album chosen from Explore returned a full-page 503 Service Unavailable during the mobile capture, preventing content viewing.
findings.suggestedFix: Stabilize album delivery and add bounded retries/failover so detail routes do not intermittently terminate the primary browse journey.

findings.summary: Service-unavailable states provide no recovery action.
findings.evidence: The captured 503 state only says no server is available and “We’ll be back soon”; it has no retry, back, Explore, or status link.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide an actionable, localized error shell with Retry, Back to Explore, preserved context, and a support/status route.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP is outside the good range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 5.6s, FCP 2.8s, Speed Index 5.0s, and performance 0.71 on Explore; the independent trace measured LCP 1.77s in a warmer/faster run, showing variability.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP candidate, reduce render-blocking dependencies, and verify under repeatable mobile throttling until LCP is under 2.5s.

findings.summary: Parser-blocking resources delay rendering.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 1,700ms savings from render-blocking resources. HAR and DOM confirm parser-inserted classic libraries.js/main.js without async/defer, plus three blocking stylesheets.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical classic scripts, inline only critical CSS, and avoid duplicate font stylesheet loading.

findings.summary: Most shipped CSS and substantial JavaScript are unused on the primary listing.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 213KiB unused JS and 31KiB unused CSS; ad-provider.js was 92% unused and the two first-party stylesheets were 87-94% unused.
findings.suggestedFix: Split route bundles, remove dead framework CSS, and load ad/analytics code only when it provides explicit user value.

findings.summary: Some images and inputs lack accessible alternatives.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found two images without alt text in the disclaimer; the login probe found captcha and search inputs without labels or aria-labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Use empty alt for decorative imagery, descriptive alt for the logo, and explicit labels/names for captcha and search.

findings.summary: Focus visibility fails despite otherwise reasonable heading structure.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse passed heading order and main landmark, but the direct focus walk found no outline or box-shadow on visible navigation controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Add consistent :focus-visible styles and test the full tab order at desktop and mobile breakpoints.

findings.summary: Several images omit intrinsic dimensions or responsive sizing.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 16 images missing dimensions and 20 missing srcset; Lighthouse also flagged the unsized vertical logo and a low-resolution logo.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width/height or aspect-ratio to every image and responsive srcset/sizes for content imagery and logos.

findings.summary: Deprecated unload handling and no-store policy block BFCache.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported a deprecated unload listener and four BFCache failure reasons, including the unload handler and Cache-Control: no-store.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace unload with pagehide/visibilitychange and scope no-store only to responses that truly require it.

findings.summary: The large public site has no sitemap endpoint.
findings.evidence: Canonical, hreflang, robots meta, and successful status were present, but /sitemap.xml returned 404 while robots.txt only disallowed /cams/.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish sitemap indexes for discoverable album/listing URLs and reference them from robots.txt.

findings.summary: Listing pages expose no structured data or social-preview metadata.
findings.evidence: The metadata probe found zero JSON-LD blocks and zero Open Graph/Twitter tags on Explore.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate WebSite/CollectionPage and content-level schema.org JSON-LD plus Open Graph/Twitter cards matching visible content.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS, but CSP and cookie posture are weak.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence shows no CSP or nosniff. Cookie evidence found analytics cookies without Secure, SameSite=None, and 400-day expiry; session/XSRF cookies also use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash CSP, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Secure analytics cookies, and the narrowest workable SameSite policy.

findings.summary: Tracking and ad code load by default with a broad origin footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker capture observed 35 non-host origins and active Google Tag Manager/Analytics. HAR shows GTM as the largest resource at 153KB plus two ad-network scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Require an explicit privacy basis/consent where applicable, defer non-essential trackers, minimize event retention, and remove low-value ad dependencies.

findings.summary: Email authentication is password-only and does not offer passkeys.
findings.evidence: The sign-in form contains email/password/captcha, no autocomplete=webauthn, and no evidence of WebAuthn, although third-party OAuth choices are available.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey sign-in/registration alongside federated and password recovery, using conditional mediation where supported.

findings.summary: Clickjacking and privacy-enforcement headers are absent.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence found no X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors, no Referrer-Policy, and no Permissions-Policy; HSTS was the one strong defense present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and evaluate Trusted Types/origin isolation for high-risk script surfaces.

findings.summary: The app advertises installability but has no service worker or offline fallback.
findings.evidence: /manifest.json declares standalone display and icons, while the service-worker probe found zero registrations and no controller.
findings.suggestedFix: Register a small service worker with an offline navigation shell and explicit fallback for unavailable media.

findings.summary: Network/service failure falls through to an unbranded, non-actionable error document.
findings.evidence: The album capture produced a generic English 503 page with no retry or preserved navigation, unlike the useful 404 page that retains content recommendations.
findings.suggestedFix: Use the branded application error shell for 5xx/network failures and expose retry/back actions without losing the requested URL.

findings.summary: Localized markup is correct, but CSS is overwhelmingly physical-direction based.
findings.evidence: The page correctly declares lang=es and 17 hreflang variants, but CSS inspection counted 1,436 physical left/right/width/height declarations versus only two logical-property uses; dir is implicit LTR.
findings.suggestedFix: Set explicit direction where needed and migrate component spacing/inset/alignment to logical properties so translated and RTL variants can reflow.

findings.summary: Form errors rely on browser bubbles and are not localized or announced inline.
findings.evidence: Invalid login submission focused email but exposed English “Please fill in this field” messages on a Spanish page, with no aria-invalid, aria-describedby, role=alert, or aria-live region.
findings.suggestedFix: Render localized inline errors after interaction, connect them with aria-describedby, set aria-invalid, and announce the summary.

findings.summary: Sign-in inputs omit autofill tokens.
findings.evidence: The email and password controls have empty autocomplete values, captcha is unlabeled, and the only explicit autocomplete setting disables search autofill.
findings.suggestedFix: Add autocomplete=username and current-password; label captcha and preserve browser/password-manager assistance.

findings.summary: The media listing does not use modern responsive image delivery consistently.
findings.evidence: Images evidence found 37 legacy-format images, zero modern-format images, 20 missing srcset, and 16 missing dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, add srcset/sizes, and preserve intrinsic dimensions for each media card.

findings.summary: Large non-core scripts consume bandwidth despite little route usage.
findings.evidence: GTM (153KB), ad-provider.js (52KB), and tsyndicate (24KB) are among the largest transfers; Lighthouse reports 45-92% of these scripts unused.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate analytics/ads behind user value and consent, batch analytics, and conditionally import route-specific code.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts dominate more of the initial budget than the content needs.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 459KB across 59 requests; three analytics/ad scripts account for roughly half the transfer, while tracker capture identified GTM and Analytics.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget, defer non-critical vendors, and cache or self-host stable assets where policy permits.
